decisions.statement: A library is named by the slug a caller spells on the command line.
Each library names the package its copied data is written into.
Each library names the upstream files its data is read out of.
Those files are named against the addons directory rather than as whole paths.
A name that is no library is answered as no library rather than refused here.
A copy differing from upstream is told apart from a run that broke.

definition: which community ESO libraries temper copies data out of
